paper_title: Spatial Variation and Uncertainty Analysis of Black Sea Level Change from Virtual Altimetry Stations over 1993–2020
evidence_summary: Atlas paper 153 explicitly compares its estimated Black Sea sea-level trend with the CMEMS OMI_CLIMATE_SL_BLKSEA_area_averaged_anomalies product and gives DOI 10.48670/moi-00215. The official Copernicus Marine record independently verifies that DOI and product identity. Existing Stage-1 relationship PRL000032 is therefore verified.
evidence_location: paper sea-level-trend comparison; official product description, DOI and documentation

paper_title: A Glacier Ice Thickness Estimation Method Based on Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
evidence_summary: Atlas paper 156 states that GlaThiDa data are available at the official GTN-G GlaThiDa URL and uses GlaThiDa glacier-thickness measurements in its cross-regional evaluation. The original source note/Stage-1 URL contains a host transcription typo, repaired as VA000054 without changing CR000281 or PRL000033. The official GTN-G catalogue independently verifies GlaThiDa 3.1.0 and DOI 10.5904/wgms-glathida-2020-10.
evidence_location: paper study data and Data Availability Statement; official GlaThiDa catalogue; Stage-1 source line 463

paper_title: A Glacier Ice Thickness Estimation Method Based on Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
evidence_summary: Atlas paper 156 states that RGI is available at the exact GLIMS RGI URL represented by CR000282 and explicitly identifies Randolph Glacier Inventory version 7.0 in the study. The official GLIMS/RGI documentation independently verifies RGI 7.0 and DOI 10.5067/f6jmovy5navz. Existing Stage-1 relationship PRL000034 is verified.
evidence_location: paper Study Area and Data and Data Availability Statement; official RGI portal and user guide
